articles.title: Why Google News RSS base64 Decoding Broke (2024–2026) — And How to Fix It for AI RAG & MCP
articles.excerpt: If you've built an AI news agent, market monitor, or RAG pipeline using Google News RSS, you've probably watched your scraper silently break on tags like: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi...…
articles.body: If you've built an AI news agent, market monitor, or RAG pipeline using Google News RSS, you've probably watched your scraper silently break on <link> tags like: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi... In 2024–2026, Google shifted new CBMi protobuf payloads from embedding plain https://... URLs in field 4 to embedding opaque AU_yqL... tokens. Classic base64 slices only return garbage or redirect HTML instead of the actual Bloomberg, TechCrunch, or Reuters article. How Modern Decoding Works ( Fbv4je ) Inspect protobuf varint field 4 — legacy items resolve offline; modern AU_yqL items fetch data-n-a-sg and data-n-a-ts attributes from the splash page.

articles.title: How to Verify Telegram Mini App initData Safely in TypeScript (Zero Dependencies)
articles.excerpt: Most Telegram Mini App tutorials verify initData with a naive === hash comparison and skip timestamp checks. In production, that leaves your backend exposed to replay attacks, timing attacks, and malf…
articles.body: Most Telegram Mini App tutorials verify initData with a naive === hash comparison and skip timestamp checks. In production, that leaves your backend exposed to replay attacks, timing attacks, and malformed user payloads. Here is the exact zero-dependency TypeScript pattern we use to validate Telegram initData cleanly before issuing any session token. The 5 Security Checks You Should Never Skip Validate the hash format first: Reject anything that is not a valid 64-character hex string before touching crypto buffers. Sort parameters alphabetically (excluding hash ): Build the data_check_string using \n separators from URLSearchParams . Derive the secret key properly: Telegram signs initData using HMAC-SHA256 with "WebAppData" as the key and your BOT_TOKEN as the message.

articles.body: An on-device model can be ready without a network connection while the application around it still fails to reopen. The model works; the HTML, JavaScript, fonts, or saved input do not. From the user’s perspective, the feature is still offline and unavailable. An offline promise therefore needs an interaction-level test. Close or reload the page without connectivity and check whether the person can recover their work, use the available features, and understand what is unavailable. The companion implements a small React brief editor with local draft storage and a versioned application cache. Native AI remains optional and independently checked.

articles.title: Resend "You can only send testing emails to your own email address": the fix and the security check
articles.excerpt: Resend returns an error like: You can only send testing emails to your own email address What it means How to fix it Confirm the From address. If it uses the shared testing sender, that is the cause.…
articles.body: Resend returns an error like: You can only send testing emails to your own email address What it means Your request is using Resend's testing setup. In that mode you can only send to your own account email. To send to other people, you need a sending domain you own and have verified with Resend. How to fix it Confirm the From address. If it uses the shared testing sender, that is the cause. Add and verify your own domain in Resend, following Resend's current DNS steps. Change the From address on your server to an address at that domain, for example notifications@your-domain.com . Send a test to an address that is not yours. Keep the key on the server The Resend API key must be used only in server code.

articles.body: Astronomers witnessed the spectacular cosmic indigestion that resulted from a red giant star that devoured a stellar Bao bun in the form of its smaller companion star. That isn't a random comparison. The cannibal star, which is 350 times bigger than the sun, is nicknamed "Big Bao," while its unfortunate companion had the nickname "Little Bao." The cute cosmic monikers come from the fact that this destructive merger event has been designated AT2025abao. A Bao bun might be a little snack for a human, but this red giant star made a real meal out of Little Bao. This cannibalistic event was tracked by a wide array of ground- and space-based telescopes, including NASA space missions NEOWISE, SPHEREx, and the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), as well as the W. M. Keck Observatory in Hawaii.

articles.title: 'Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home' at 40: 'Trek' has never been as joyous or fun as in 'the one with the whales'
articles.excerpt: Colorful metaphors, a near-miss with Eddie Murphy and humpback whales in 20th-century California.
articles.body: It may have been subtitled "The Voyage Home", but to most viewers "Star Trek IV" (which has just turned 40) will always be "the one with the whales". After "The Wrath of Khan" and "The Search for Spock" went to some pretty dark places — ear worms, the destruction of the Enterprise, the death (and later resurrection) of a certain beloved Vulcan — the franchise was in need of some light relief. So what better than to set coordinates for the then-present day of 1986 San Francisco, for a time-travel comedy romp? Spock himself, Leonard Nimoy, had directed "The Search for Spock" and Paramount had lined him up to call the shots on a follow-up before the movie had even landed in theaters.
